name: Federal Workforce Data (FWD)
what_it_illuminates: Monthly federal headcount, accessions and separations by type, agency, series, age and veteran status
latest_release_or_status: Launched Jan 2026; replaces FedScope (as recorded by FH)
integration_detail: Baseline M-04/M-14/M-20: separations by type and accessions by series (0401, 0404, 0454, 0455, 0456, 0460, 0462, 0486, 0819, 1315) per year; prior-employment linkage needs a research agreement for EHRI microdata

name: LEHD Job-to-Job Flows (J2J)
sector_focus: all sectors (public administration NAICS 92 vs private)
what_it_illuminates: Employer-to-employer worker flows by state, industry and worker characteristics
integration_detail: Trend public-to-private and state flows for environmental industries (M-24); context for rival explanations, not attribution

name: Current Population Survey occupational transitions (via IPUMS-CPS)
what_it_illuminates: Month-to-month and annual occupation changes used in occupational mobility networks
integration_detail: Validate SOC-level similarity after role->SOC crosswalks are fixed; small cells for environmental SOCs (pool years)

name: Lightcast (postings, profiles, Open Skills)
what_it_illuminates: Posting requirements, skill clusters, career-profile transitions
integration_detail: Posting-language and degree-screen metrics (M-26, M-27); licensed career-history transitions for pathway validation (M-03); vendor-neutral use only via exported, versioned extracts

name: Revelio Labs (workforce dynamics from online profiles)
what_it_illuminates: Role-to-role and employer-to-employer transitions from career histories
integration_detail: Held-out career histories for predicted-vs-observed pathway tests; check coverage bias against field and seasonal workers, who are under-represented online

name: Burning Glass Institute (skills-based hiring and credential fluency research)
what_it_illuminates: Whether skills-based hiring changes hiring; what operational practices move it
integration_detail: Adopt the 'leaders / in name only / backsliders' typology to classify pilot adopters; replicate the credential-fluency measure for public employers

name: NGA skills-based hiring work (Center for Best Practices) and Opportunity@Work
what_it_illuminates: State government degree-requirement removal and implementation case studies (e.g. Colorado)
integration_detail: Recruit 3+ state partners for G1 (M-10); align EMST minimum-qualification exports to state skills-based hiring practice

name: State programmes and partnerships to hire displaced federal workers
what_it_illuminates: Observed federal-to-state/local transitions in 2025-26
latest_release_or_status: Partnership May 2025; state recruitment Feb 2025 (as recorded by FS)
integration_detail: Natural experiment for pathway validation: ask partner states for aggregate counts of hires with prior federal service by class and former series

name: The Corps Network
what_it_illuminates: Corps scale (140 members; >22,000/year); service-to-career practice
latest_release_or_status: Service to Career Pathways framework Apr 2026
integration_detail: Map JFF/TCN's seven pillars to EMST entry role profiles; recruit panel stratum S-D; ask TCN to co-define corps alumni outcome metrics (none published)

name: AmeriCorps (national service funding for corps)
what_it_illuminates: Corps entry-path funding stability
latest_release_or_status: FY2026 status litigated; stay to 2027-02-01 (as recorded by AS)
integration_detail: Track as external factor X3 for entry cohort metric M-20

name: Grassroots Wildland Firefighters
what_it_illuminates: Firefighter pay, classification, mental health and retention testimony
integration_detail: Recruit panel stratum S-E; source of lived-experience testimony on fire career barriers

name: Federal employee unions (e.g. AFGE; NFFE for Forest Service)
what_it_illuminates: Members' interests in hiring, RIF and reassignment; litigation (AFGE v. Kupor)
latest_release_or_status: AFGE v. Kupor stay of Merit Hiring Plan essay Q3 (Sep 2026)
integration_detail: Panel stratum S-F; co-write the misuse policy (M-11); NFFE details not verified this session

name: Partnership for Public Service (Fed Figures; Federal Harms Tracker)
what_it_illuminates: Federal workforce size, separations, age and veteran composition; harms of 2025-26 changes
integration_detail: Baseline for entry-path metrics (under-30 share; student trainees; NPS and USFS losses)

name: Green 2.0 transparency report card
what_it_illuminates: Diversity of environmental NGO and foundation staff, senior staff and boards
latest_release_or_status: 2024 report reported first decline in NGO staff of colour (secondhand); current edition not accessed
integration_detail: Sector benchmark for equity metric M-17 and panel composition

name: Jobs and Skills Australia - National Skills Taxonomy (successor to ASC)
what_it_illuminates: How a national system handles skills portability and similarity; maintenance risk
latest_release_or_status: NST in development; ASC decommissioned after Dec 2023 final update
integration_detail: Lessons: similarity (Skills Transitions) shipped without flow validation; ASC retired. EMST should validate pathways (M-03) and fund stewardship (M-29)

name: SkillsFuture Singapore evaluation studies
what_it_illuminates: Wage and placement outcomes of skills programmes
integration_detail: Borrow outcome-metric design (wage premium vs matched comparison; placements) for G2 outcome metrics

name: ESCO (and its use in public employment services)
what_it_illuminates: Occupation-skill links used for profiling and matching
latest_release_or_status: Greek PES (DYPA) use 2025; success KPIs uptake-based
integration_detail: Benchmark warning: measure outcomes, not downloads. ESCO KPIs never moved beyond uptake

name: NICE Workforce Framework for Cybersecurity
what_it_illuminates: A federal-context framework for fast-changing work roles
latest_release_or_status: Adoption evidence is descriptive or vendor self-report
integration_detail: Do not cite NICE as proof that frameworks increase mobility. Adopt its statement-ID versioning (CA's lane)

name: Learning and Employment Record pilots (T3 Innovation Network; Experience You Project; JFF)
owner_or_host: U.S. Chamber of Commerce Foundation; JFF; Education Design Lab
what_it_illuminates: Whether portable verifiable records change hiring
latest_release_or_status: Pilots report technical portability and badge counts, no hiring outcomes (2024-25)
integration_detail: Emit EMST competency IDs into Open Badges 3.0/CLR assertions (IA/LC); measure hiring effects ourselves (M-14)

name: Chance to Compete Act implementation (technical assessments; USA Hire)
what_it_illuminates: Shift of the federal hiring gate from self-ratings to assessed skills
latest_release_or_status: Implementation plan to Congress Jul 2026 (as recorded by FH)
integration_detail: Map EMST competencies with indicators to USA Hire and SME-QA assessment content for target series; the main lever for A3-prime

name: US Wildland Fire Service and 2026 qualifications transition plan
owner_or_host: Department of the Interior; NWCG interagency workgroup
what_it_illuminates: Consolidation of fire roles; qualification alignment
latest_release_or_status: USWFS stood up Jan 2026; aligned quals Jan 2027
integration_detail: Crosswalk EMST fire role profiles to aligned qualification standards; track intra-federal mobility

name: Intergovernmental Personnel Act mobility assignments
what_it_illuminates: Temporary assignments across federal, state, local, Tribal, university and eligible nonprofit employers without changing employer
integration_detail: Ready-made cross-actor mobility mechanism: pathway view should surface IPA as an option; metric of IPA assignments by pathway

name: Co-delivery agreements (Good Neighbor Authority; shared stewardship; special use permits to counties)
owner_or_host: USFS/DOI with states, counties and Tribes
what_it_illuminates: Where environmental work crosses sector-actor boundaries and needs cross-actor staff
integration_detail: Treat agreement-based work as demand signals for cross-actor role variants; case studies for impact metric M-23 (SC owns the statecraft content)

name: Five Functional Positions framework
owner_or_host: Environmental Policy Innovation Center / Digital Service for the Planet
what_it_illuminates: Bridging competencies between data-to-decision positions
integration_detail: Candidate work-function facet for role profiles; test position adjacency as a predictor of internal moves

name: Skill-similarity and occupational-mobility network methods (Dawson et al. 2021; del Rio-Chanona et al. 2021; Frank et al. 2019)
owner_or_host: Academic (PLOS ONE; J R Soc Interface; PNAS)
what_it_illuminates: How to compute asymmetric skill similarity and validate it against observed flows
integration_detail: Implement RCA-weighted asymmetric similarity on L2 task bundles and evaluate against observed moves (M-03)
